exact_statement: For every finite fixed rational gate table with nonempty supports, positive normalized dictionary-size and local-subset laws, the dictionary-first generator and its finite output quotient admit computable prefix decoders with each selected gate name occurring once in the record and canonical roots/attachments requiring no extra fields. On the sunflower f_m=x0-(1+x0)*prod_i(1-x_i)/2 for every integer m>=1, the specified normalized output reference has nonempty spectral expected ideal cost <25I(f_m)/4 and full-output prefix expected length <33I(f_m)/4; raw latent-record cost is at least (1-2^-m)^2 log2(m). Ordinary addressing has a dedicated exact 2a-bit code.
hypotheses: uniform sign cube for Boolean application
fixed rational structural model known to encoder and decoder
dictionary subset laws positive on all nonempty local subsets
sample-dependent model selection is paid by a fixed normalized prior
output quotient need not recover original latent record
